subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should maintainers require a live Discord reproduction before authorizing a repair PR for this issue?
rationale: Current source proves the generic resolver and the exact missing-ID error path, but it does not identify whether Discord is losing the state root, media ID, or file lifetime in current main.

options.title: Require live Discord proof first
options.body: Run a real Discord DM attachment repro or collect targeted runtime logs before choosing the repair boundary.

options.title: Queue a source-only investigation
options.body: Allow a repair worker to add a focused Discord/media projection regression first, stopping if the current failure cannot be reproduced in code.

options.title: Close as generic resolver fixed
options.body: Treat the existing `media://inbound` support as sufficient, accepting the risk that the Discord-specific missing-file report remains real.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof first
recommendation.body: Run a real Discord DM attachment repro or collect targeted runtime logs before choosing the repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The generic media-reference fix and image-tool boundary are the central shared surface, with Discord/lifetime owners available for follow-up.
